name: add_mcp_server
description:
Add an MCP server to the configuration (tools.mcp.servers). The server is saved to config.json, a connection is attempted immediately, and the result reports live connection status and tool count.
Parameters: name (required), transport (stdio/sse/http; default stdio), command (required for stdio), url (required for sse/http), args, env.

name: configure_channel
description:
Configure an enabled channel with its credentials (token, phone_number, etc).
Parameters: id (required), plus channel-specific credentials.

name: configure_provider
description:
Add or update an LLM provider with its API key.
Parameters: name (required), api_key (for cloud), api_base (optional).

name: create_agent
description: Create a new agent with personality, model, tools, and configuration. Use agent_type to choose the runtime: 'Main' (default, native chat colleague), 'Subagent' (native delegation-only worker), or 'subagent_3p' (delegation-only worker on an external CLI — set cli and cli_path).

name: create_skill
description: Author a NEW skill (procedural memory). Writes a SKILL.md to the user skills directory; the write is consent-gated and versioned. Parameters: name (required, alphanumeric+hyphens), content (required, full SKILL.md including YAML frontmatter with name and description).

name: create_task_in_workspace
description:
Create a task on the workspace board. Call this when the user wants to create, add, or track a task or action item. If the user mentioned a workspace name, call list_workspaces first to get the workspace_id.
Parameters: name (required, the task title), description (optional), prompt (optional, agent instruction), workspace_id (required, from list_workspaces), agent_id (optional, agent to assign), status (optional: inbox=new/untriaged, next=ready, in_progress, blocked, done, failed — defaults to inbox), due (optional, RFC 3339 due date/time), priority (optional, 1 highest to 5 lowest, default 3), plan_id (optional, ID of the Plan this task is a member of — must exist in the same workspace and must not be a terminal plan), blocked_by (optional, array of task IDs this task is blocked by), criteria (REQUIRED when agent_id is set: at least one acceptance criterion / Definition of Done).

name: create_workspace
description:
Create a new workspace to group related tasks. Call this when the user mentions starting a new workspace, initiative, or area of work. Returns the created workspace's id — pass this id to create_task_in_workspace when creating tasks for the workspace.
Parameters: name (required, workspace title), description (optional, free text), core_team (optional, list of agent IDs associated with this workspace).

name: delete_agent
description:
Delete an agent and all its data (sessions, memory, workspace).
Parameters: id (required), confirm (bool, must be true).

name: delete_task_in_workspace
description: Delete a task. Parameters: id (required), confirm (bool, must be true).

name: delete_workspace
description:
Delete a workspace and all its tasks. This is irreversible — all GTD tasks belonging to the workspace are permanently deleted. Call list_workspaces first to find the workspace id. Requires confirm:true.
Parameters: id (required), confirm (bool, must be true to prevent accidental deletion).

name: disable_channel
description:
Disable a channel connection. The channel will stop on the next config reload.
Parameters: id (required, the channel type e.g. 'telegram', 'discord').

name: edit_skill
description: Edit / refine an EXISTING skill (self-improvement). Snapshots the prior version for rollback, then writes the new SKILL.md. Editing a built-in creates a user override; the built-in is never mutated in place. The write is consent-gated and versioned. Parameters: name (required), content (required, full new SKILL.md).

name: enable_channel
description:
Enable a channel connection. The channel will start on the next config reload.
Parameters: id (required, the channel type e.g. 'telegram', 'discord').

name: get_config
description:
Read a configuration value by dot-notation key.
Parameters: key (required, e.g. 'gateway.port').

name: get_usage
description:
Query token usage by period, agent, model, or session.
Parameters:
  period   — time window: day, week, month (default), or all
  by       — grouping dimension: agent (default), model, or session
  agent_id — optional: restrict to a single agent
  session_id — optional: restrict to a single session
Returns input, output, cache-read, cache-write, and total token counts.
No dollar amounts — token counts only.
External CLI subagents (subagent_3p) run on a separate engine and are excluded.

name: get_workspace
description:
Get a single workspace by ID including its live task count. Use this to refresh workspace data after creating tasks.
Parameters: id (required, from list_workspaces).

name: list_channels
description: List all channels with status and implementation tier. No parameters required.

name: list_mcp_servers
description: List all MCP servers configured in tools.mcp.servers with their transport and enabled state. No parameters required.

name: list_models
description: List available models from configured providers. Optional: filter by provider name. Returns model slugs, provider, and whether it's the system default.

name: list_providers
description: List configured providers with connection status. API keys are never returned. No parameters required.

name: list_skills
description: List all installed skills. No parameters required.

name: list_tasks_in_workspace
description:
List YOUR OWN tasks across workspaces: tasks assigned to you, plus tasks you created for other agents. It never returns another agent's or a human's tasks, so an empty result means you have no matching work — not that the workspace is empty. Bounded to the 100 most recently updated matches; `truncated` and `matched` say when there were more.
Parameters: workspace_id, agent_id, status (all optional, all narrow the result further).

name: list_workspaces
description:
List all active workspaces with their task counts. Call this to find workspace ids before calling create_task_in_workspace, list_tasks_in_workspace, or update_workspace. Returns newest workspaces first.
Parameters: status (optional: active/archived/all, defaults to active).

name: read_agent_metadata
description: Read one of an agent's metadata files: SOUL.md (personality, persona, system prompt and behavioural instructions), HEARTBEAT.md (proactive schedule), MEMORY.md (procedural/episodic memory), or AGENT.md (frontmatter config). Defaults to the calling agent's own files; pass agent_id to read another agent's. There is no per-target permission check — any agent granted this tool can read any agent's metadata, including MEMORY.md.

name: remove_mcp_server
description:
Remove an MCP server from the configuration (tools.mcp.servers) and persist the change.
Parameters: name (required), confirm (bool, must be true).

name: remove_skill
description: Remove an installed skill. Parameters: name (required, the skill id as reported by list_skills — no path separators), confirm (bool, must be true).

name: run_doctor
description: Run security diagnostics and return a risk score (0-100) with actionable recommendations. No parameters required.

name: set_config
description:
Update a configuration value.
Parameters: key (required), value (required).

name: test_channel
description:
Test a channel's configuration — checks the channel exists, is enabled, and has credentials configured.
Parameters: id (required, the channel type e.g. 'telegram', 'discord').

name: test_provider
description: Test a provider connection. Parameters: name (required).

name: update_agent
description: Update an existing agent's configuration. Only provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left as-is.

name: update_task_in_workspace
description:
Update an existing task. Call this to change status, reassign, rename, or link to a workspace. Use list_tasks_in_workspace first to find the task id.
Parameters: id (required, from list_tasks_in_workspace), name, description, prompt, workspace_id, agent_id, status (inbox/next/blocked/done/failed — in_progress is reached only through real dispatch via run_task, never written directly here), due (RFC 3339), priority (1 highest to 5 lowest), blocked_by (array of task IDs, replaces existing list), result (completion summary; used as the judge's claim text — required in practice for a done claim on a task with acceptance criteria, since only the criteria's own assignee running that task can force one through). Only provided fields are updated. A status:"done" call on a task with acceptance criteria is NOT applied immediately — it is adjudicated by the judge during that task's own run.

name: update_workspace
description:
Update an existing workspace's name, description, status, pin state, or core team. Call this when the user wants to rename, archive, pin, or reconfigure a workspace. Use list_workspaces first to find the workspace id.
Parameters: id (required, from list_workspaces), name, description, status (active/archived), pinned (bool), pin_order (int), core_team (list of agent IDs). Only provided fields are updated.
